title: Composing Music with AI: The Convergence of Human Lyrics & Algorithmic Sound
content:
One of my favorite features of EmoWords is our Songs repository—a dynamic sandbox where lyrical human poetry meets next-generation generative audio engineering.


🎵 How I Compose AI-Assisted Tracks

While artificial intelligence can synthesize complex instruments and harmonies in seconds, the authentic emotional resonant heartbeat always comes from original human lyrics. When crafting songs for this application:

  • Step 1 (The Soul): I compose raw, introspective lyrics reflecting authentic human experiences.
  • Step 2 (The Soundscape): I calibrate generative acoustic models and musical prompts (such as melodic acoustic folk, synthwave, or lo-fi ambient beats) to wrap around the emotional cadences of the poetry.
  • Step 3 (The Integration): By pairing customized album cover artworks with built-in interactive audio soundtrack players, visitors can listen to full musical arrangements while appreciating the written poetry.

Explore the Songs category above to hear how technology amplifies lyrical storytelling!

title: Serverless Deep Dive: Overcoming Cloud HTTP Payload Limits with Browser Canvas Optimization
content:
When deploying web applications on serverless edge networks (such as Vercel or AWS Lambda), developers inevitably encounter hard infrastructure API constraints—most notably a strict 4.5 MB HTTP POST payload limit.


The Challenge of High-Def Media Uploads

In modern social and portfolio platforms, users routinely attempt to attach raw 12MB smartphone pictures or high-resolution AI-generated PNG artwork. Sending these uncompressed files over standard API endpoints immediately triggers an HTTP 413 (Request Entity Too Large) error before application logic even runs.


Our Zero-Friction Client-Side Solution

To deliver a seamless, intuitive user experience on EmoWords without adding expensive cloud object storage overhead for simple photos, we engineered an automatic in-browser image optimization engine:

  1. Real-Time File Interception: When a user selects a picture over 1 MB, the frontend reads the data array before network submission.
  2. HTML5 Canvas Scaling: The browser generates an in-memory 2D Canvas, caps maximum visual resolution to 2K (2560px), and strips redundant metadata.
  3. High-Fidelity JPEG Encoding: The raw PNG/photo is re-serialized into a pristine 85%-quality JPEG Blob, transforming an 11 MB upload into an ultra-fast ~400 KB payload in under 200 milliseconds.

Engineering elegant software means solving technical hurdles invisibly, empowering creators to simply share their creativity!

title: Grandma's Secret Pasta
content:
Ingredients:

  • 500g fresh artisan pasta
  • 3 cloves crushed roasted garlic
  • Extra virgin olive oil
  • Fresh picked fragrant basil
  • Pecorino Romano cheese

Instructions: Boil pasta until perfectly al dente. Sauté garlic in olive oil until a golden toasted crust appears. Toss hot pasta with oil, fresh basil, and a generous grating of pecorino cheese. Serve immediately!
